{"subject":"Predictable p99 for multi-region fraud scoring","body":"Hi Tom,

Northwind Payments runs fraud scoring on Astra DB, where single-digit millisecond reads across three regions at 40k transactions per second are the bar. Your team is also focusing on capacity planning and on cost and latency improvements for the multi-region data layer.

I'm Oz, GTM Engineer at ScyllaDB. For latency-sensitive workloads like fraud scoring, ScyllaDB's shard-per-core C++ architecture has no JVM garbage-collection pauses, which keeps p99 latency predictable.

Would a short technical write-up on how that works be useful?

Reply STOP to opt out.","evidence_ids":["s01","s02"],"value_prop_ids":["vp_latency"],"context_fact_ids":[]}
